source_excerpts.text:
## III. Persistent multivalent DNA-binding islands

A completed run of adjacent clicked junctions gives an island bearing multiple PNA adapters. If each of m bound arms leaves at rate u and each unbound arm rebinds intramolecularly at rate a, the number n of arms bound forms a birth-death chain, n->n-1 at n*u, n->n+1 at (m-n)*a. n=0 absorbs to a perfect wash sink. Starting n=m, exact mean clearance time is

E[T_m]=sum_{n=1}^m (1/(n*u))*sum_{j=n}^m [C(m,j)/C(m,n)] (a/u)^(j-n).

If a=0, E[T_m]=H_m/u, logarithmic in m. If a>0, its n=1 term alone gives lower bound

E[T_m]>=((1+a/u)^m-1)/(m*a),

so unrestrained rebinding creates exponential trapping. Example hypothetical u=a=.3/s: m=14 mean 4275.4s (71.3 min), while a=0 gives only 10.84s. The calculation does not assert rates of the 2013 macrocyclic PNA adapters. Under independent Bernoulli edge success probability .6 on a 1000-edge template, there is a 26.7% chance of at least one run of 14 successful adjacent edges; other downstream islands may thus contain many binding arms. Distribution computed exactly by a finite-run-length Markov chain.

**Physical mechanism:** active suppression of rebinding during displacement, plus a selective sink, is not merely speeding a wash; it changes the asymptotic clearance law. Precedent for other PNA systems: polymerase-mediated duplex displacement, Brudno et al 2010. Must show displacement of *multi-adapter CuAAC islands* while preserving product and root registration, not infer it from single PNA4 kinetics.

def multivalent_stripping_time(m,u,a):
    """Exact mean time to 0 bound arms in birth-death chain: n->n-1 at n*u,
    n->n+1 at (m-n)*a, starting n=m, 0 an absorbing wash sink.
    Arms exchange and rebind independently; real PNA may be cooperative.
    """
    assert m>=1 and u>0 and a>=0
    r=a/u
    ans=0.
    for n in range(1,m+1):
        term=sum((comb(m,k)/comb(m,n))*r**(k-n) for k in range(n,m+1))
        ans+=term/(n*u)
    return ans


def stripping_lower_bound(m,u,a):
    """First summand of exact mean; exponential in m for a>0."""
    if a==0:return 1/u
    return (math.pow(1+a/u,m)-1)/(m*a)


def prefix_ratchet(L,p,quantile=.99):
    """Each round tries every remaining edge independently; only rooted
    contiguous prefix is retained after denaturing clearance; detached
    islands discarded; next round refills downstream. Thus rounds to finish
    are 1+NegBin(L,p) number of failures before L successes.
    """
    expected=1+L*(1-p)/p
    variance=L*(1-p)/p**2
    quant=int(nbinom.ppf(quantile,L,p))+1
    return expected,math.sqrt(variance),quant


def all_edges_held_rounds(L,p,F=.99):
    return math.ceil(math.log(-math.expm1(math.log(F)/L))/math.log1p(-p))


def packet_prefix_quantile(L,b,p,F=.99):
    """N=L/b parallel independently rooted packets, each self-cleared.
    This *excludes* final packet joining and connector damage!
    """
    assert L % b==0
    N=L//b
    x=1
    while nbinom.cdf(x-1,b,p)**N<F:
        x+=1
    return x


def packet_all_correct(L,b,beta_over_k,gate_failure):
    """Fidelity bound for isolated packets of b junctions: all-to-all
    wrong partner CuAAC inside each packet, while packet joins each have
    independent failed gate with probability gate_failure. Finite L %b=0.
    No overlap or incomplete packet handling; comparator only.
    """
    assert L % b==0
    N=L//b
    f=all_partner_correct(b,beta_over_k)
    return f**N*(1-gate_failure)**(N-1)
